strategy.name: XAU_Bollinger_Reversal_5m_v9
strategy.rationale: Mean-reversion at Bollinger extremes is orthogonal to trend-follow approaches. Band touch plus RSI exhaustion plus momentum reversal. Short holds, tight stops, spread tiny vs band width.

history.analysis: WR 19%, PF 0.27, all exit types losing. Stops dominate losses (-$135). Time exits near breakeven suggests setups lack directional edge. Spread cost ($29.88) meaningful but not primary killer—bad entries are.
mistakes: Trend-following entries against intraday noise: longs at 4101/4105 immediately reversed, showing SMA50 trend filter is too slow to define short-term direction
Stop losses too tight relative to ATR on early versions (v2/v3 BTC stops hit in 3-12m), then switched to 1.2% stop on XAU which is wide but TP at 3x still rarely reached in 180m window
Trading BTC with 0.02% spread but v2/v3 used wide stops and no volatility filter—8 of 9 BTC trades stopped out, net -$67
Session filter 07-16 UTC includes low-volatility open and pre-London chop; most losses occur in first 30m of positions
changes: Drop BTC and ETH entirely—ETH spread is prohibitive, BTC edge not demonstrated in this journal
Replace RSI midline entry with breakout of N-bar high/low for genuine momentum confirmation
Tighten TP to realistic 0.6-0.8% (comfortably above 0.011% spread) with stop at 0.4% giving 1.5:1 R:R minimum
Narrow session to 08-14 UTC (London open momentum window) to avoid pre-open chop and US afternoon drift
Add ATR filter floor to ensure minimum volatility before entry so spread is small fraction of expected move

strategy.name: XAU_Bollinger_Reversal_5m_v9
strategy.rationale: Mean-reversion at Bollinger extremes is orthogonal to trend-follow approaches. Band touch plus RSI exhaustion plus momentum reversal. Short holds, tight stops, spread tiny vs band width.

history.analysis: 23 trades, WR 17%, PF 0.29: catastrophic. Stops bleed $135, wins tiny. v7 fired 0 trades—over-filtered. Core disease: counter-trend entries, stops too tight for volatility, BTC spread eats scalp edge.
mistakes: Stop exits account for 100% of losses ($134.83): stops are too tight relative to ATR noise, not too loose—price wiggles out then moves in intended direction
BTC round-trip cost 0.02% sounds small but on 1-3 min holds with 0.3-0.5% moves, spread+slippage consumes the entire edge; 9 BTC trades, all stops
WR 17% means entries are contrarian to actual flow—breakout entries firing at exhaustion tops/bottoms, not momentum continuation
v7 zero triggers in 24h: 5-condition AND-gate on XAU with session+SMA50+SMACross+15bar breakout+RSI all simultaneously true is astronomically rare
changes: Drop BTC entirely: spread cheap but 3-min holds mean spread is 30-50% of scalp range; need longer holds which conflict with scalp thesis
Never use ETH: 0.16% round trip requires 0.5%+ move to profit—impossible on 5m scalp consistently
Reduce AND-gate to max 3 conditions so setups actually fire
Use ATR filter to only trade when volatility is sufficient to cover spread with margin
Widen stop to 1.2-1.5% on XAU so noise doesn't stop out before move develops

strategy.name: XAU_Momentum_Pullback_5m_v8
strategy.rationale: XAU cheapest spread. Enter on RSI pullback-to-midline during established SMA trend with ATR confirming sufficient volatility. 3 conditions only—will actually fire. Wide stop survives noise.

history.analysis: WR 17% with PF 0.29 means losers dominate. Stops firing fast (avg 3-60m) suggests entries against momentum. Time exits profitable ($40) but stops catastrophic (-$135). Need trend-confirmation entries, not counter-trend at arbitrary RSI levels.
mistakes: Counter-trend RSI mean-reversion entries in trending markets: shorting when RSI<42 in uptrend, buying pullbacks that kept falling
Stop too tight (0.45%) relative to XAU volatility - noise stops out before trade develops, then price moves as predicted
17 of 23 trades stopped out within minutes, indicating entries timed into momentum not yet exhausted
BTC spread (0.02%) tolerable but v3 BTC trades all stopped fast - no trend filter meant trading choppy ranges
changes: Switch from mean-reversion to trend-following: only enter in direction of confirmed momentum, not against it
Widen stops to 0.7-0.9% to survive XAU noise, compensate with larger TP target 2.0-2.5% for positive expectancy
Add SMA cross as primary trend gate - no longs below bearish cross, no shorts above bullish cross
Remove ETH from all candidates - 0.16% round-trip spread requires 0.43%+ move just to break even, incompatible with scalping
Increase required momentum confirmation before entry - momentum > 0.05% not 0.0% to ensure move is real

strategy.name: XAU_Trend_Breakout_5m_v7
strategy.rationale: XAU cheapest spread (0.011%). Enter only on breakout of 15-bar high/low with trend confirmed by SMA and RSI. Wider stop avoids noise stops. Session-gated to London/NY only.

history.analysis: 17.4% WR with PF 0.29 is catastrophic. Stops dominate (-$134). Breakouts are failing immediately - likely entering on false breakouts during choppy sessions. ETH avoided (wise). Spread cost $29 on tiny winners means edge is negative before fees.
mistakes: False breakout entries: 20-bar breakout on 5m XAU triggers on noise, price reverses within 1-3 candles before TP reached - classic whipsaw at session open
Stop too tight relative to ATR: 0.28% SL on XAU with ATR often 0.05%+ per candle means stops hit on normal volatility, not actual reversals
TP:SL ratio of 2:1 never reached - winners exit on time limit ($40 time exits) but stops dominate (-$134), meaning the setup has no real edge at breakout
Trading BTC with 0.02% spread on 3-10 minute holds is fine in theory but BTC trades showed immediate reversals - momentum confirmation was insufficient
changes: Drop BTC entirely - all BTC trades lost, no edge found
Widen stop to 0.45% on XAU to survive normal volatility, raise TP to 1.2% for positive expectancy
Require breakout confirmation: price must close above N-bar high AND momentum strong - not just touch
Extend cooldown to 60min to avoid re-entering choppy regimes
Add ATR minimum filter higher (0.08%) to only trade genuine expansion, not noise

strategy.name: XAU_Trend_Pullback_5m_v6
strategy.rationale: Buy pullbacks in uptrend (price above SMA, RSI reset from overbought) during London/NY overlap. Mean-reversion within trend - avoids false breakouts, cron lag tolerable as setup persists minutes.

history.analysis: 21% WR, PF 0.34: system is trend-chasing into noise. BTC stops dominate losses ($112 stop exits). XAU time exits profitable ($40). v4 RSI<35+BB combo too rare to fire. Need wider conditions, mean-reversion bias, fewer BTC trades.
mistakes: BTC overtraded: 11/19 trades, all stops, net -$87. BTC momentum signals fire into chop, stopped immediately. Should reduce or eliminate BTC.
Stop losses too tight (0.22%) relative to ATR on 5m: price oscillates through stops before moving in intended direction.
RSI<35 + BB below_lower simultaneously is extremely rare on XAU 5m during low-volatility periods - strategy starved itself of entries for 24h.
Chasing momentum (mom>0 to confirm long after RSI oversold) adds lag and often enters after the bounce already started, reducing R:R.
changes: Drop BTC and ETH from active trading - BTC noise kills edge, ETH spread too costly.
Loosen XAU entry: RSI<38 OR RSI>62 without mandatory BB breach - let one condition suffice.
Widen SL to 0.35% to survive normal 5m ATR, raise TP to 0.55% for 1.57:1 R:R minimum.
Remove momentum confirmation on mean-reversion - it adds lag and inverts the fade logic.

strategy.name: XAU_Breakout_Session_5m_v1
strategy.rationale: Trade XAU breakouts of 20-bar high/low at London/NY open when momentum and ATR confirm expansion. Breakouts persist several candles - cron lag tolerable. Avoids mean-reversion chop in trending markets.

history.analysis: 21% WR with 0.34 PF is catastrophic. Stops hit 14/19 trades. 1m Bollinger breakouts on closed-candle cron lag chase exhausted moves. Spread costs $26 on $81 losses. No edge whatsoever.
mistakes: Chasing 1m breakouts with 5-15min cron lag: by fill time the breakout has already reversed or exhausted - entering at worst possible moment
stopLossPct 0.18% vs takeProfitPct 0.45% sounds like 2.5R but with 21% WR the math never works: need 65%+ WR at this R:R
Trading BTC on 1m with $1.95 round-trip cost requires 0.45% TP - but 1m candles rarely sustain 0.45% moves, so time-exits and stops dominate
ATR compression filter (<0.08%) combined with breakout entry is self-defeating: low ATR means no momentum, breakout quickly snaps back into range
changes: Switch to 5m candles - reduces cron lag impact, signals stay valid longer, fewer false breakouts
Use XAU-only or XAU+BTC - ETH excluded (8x spread), BTC used only if conditions very strict
Mean-reversion logic instead of breakout-chasing: fade extreme RSI after Bollinger touch, not breakout above/through
Wider SL / tighter TP ratio inverted: use higher WR setups with 1:1 R:R rather than low-WR 1:2.5
Session filter on XAU: only London/NY overlap 07:00-17:00 UTC to avoid thin-market whipsaws and weekend gap risk

strategy.name: XAU_MeanReversion_RSI_5m_v4
strategy.rationale: Fade oversold/overbought extremes on XAU during liquid hours. Mean-reversion on 5m has higher WR than breakout-chasing. Cheapest spread. Cron lag less critical - signal persists multiple candles.

history.analysis: 30% WR with PF 0.48 is deeply unprofitable. Mean-reversion fires against trend; stops hit 7/10 times. Time-exits salvage only small wins. Spread kills ETH; low ATR filter still allows trending moves.
mistakes: Mean-reversion entries taken against prevailing momentum - BTC longs repeatedly stopped as price continued falling (66442->66303, 66232->66104, 65505->65464)
ATR<0.15 filter too permissive - trades entered in directional moves masquerading as low-vol, not true consolidation
RSI<32 / price<SMA34 combo fires during strong downtrends, not genuine oversold bounces - no confirmation of reversal
0.35% stop vs 0.85% target gives 2.4R but actual WR of 30% requires >29.4% to break even - marginally viable but spread erodes it entirely
changes: Switch from mean-reversion to trend-following with momentum confirmation to align with actual market behavior
Tighten ATR filter to require genuine low-volatility consolidation before breakout, not just <0.15
Add session filter for XAU to avoid Friday close gaps and Monday opens
Reduce maxHoldMinutes to force quicker resolution - scalping should not hold 90 minutes
Use BTC and XAU only - ETH spread (0.16%) is 8x BTC and unviable for scalping at these sizes

strategy.name: BTC_XAU_Bollinger_Squeeze_v3
strategy.rationale: 1m squeeze: wait for ATR compression then Bollinger band breakout with momentum. Fast resolution reduces hold time and gap risk. XAU session-gated. Higher trade frequency offsets per-trade edge.

history.analysis: All 3 trades stopped out immediately; mean-reversion entries in trending/volatile conditions. SMA-above-price long logic contradictory (buying above SMA during dip). ATR filter too loose at 0.3%. TP/SL ratio 1.9:1 insufficient after spread drag.
mistakes: Contradictory long condition: requires price_vs_sma op '>' (price above SMA) while seeking oversold dip - these conflict, producing bad entries
0.2% stop is too tight for 5m BTC/XAU noise; all 3 trades stopped on normal wick before any reversion could occur
ATR filter <0.3% passed during genuinely volatile candles - threshold needs tightening to <0.15% to avoid choppy entries
No trend alignment filter - entering mean-reversion longs into downtrends; need confirmation that broader trend supports direction
changes: Fix price_vs_sma logic: longs require price BELOW SMA (true reversion), shorts require price ABOVE SMA
Widen stop to 0.35% and TP to 0.85% for 2.4R minimum, giving edge even at 40% WR
Tighten ATR filter to <0.15% to avoid high-volatility traps
Add SMA trend filter on longer period to confirm directional bias before entry

strategy.name: BTC_XAU_TrendReversion_Fixed
strategy.rationale: Corrected mean-reversion: price must be BELOW SMA for longs, RSI oversold, low ATR, with 200-SMA trend alignment. Wider 2.4R ratio survives spread at modest WR.

history.analysis: Pairs cheap-spread assets trading RSI extremes vs SMA: oversold pullbacks to SMA on low ATR for controlled reversion. ETH excluded due to 8x spread penalty; diversifies across uncorrelated assets.
